- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe 3: Cashew-Based Mac and Cheese includes 1 pound macaroni, 1 cup cashews, 1/2 cup water, 1/4 cup lemon juice, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 onion (diced), and 2 cloves garlic (minced).

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips on soaking cashews properly and choosing the right blender for a smooth texture.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Soaking tips include rinsing cashews, using a 1:1 ratio of cashews to water, soaking for at least 4-6 hours or overnight, and draining and rinsing after soaking.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended blenders include Vitamix, Blendtec, Breville, and KitchenAid, with a powerful motor and multiple speed settings.
